datasets.name: Dataset 1: submissions 05/13/2026 10:05:56
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  s.id AS submission_id,
  s.movements_date,
  s.created_at AS submission_created_at,
  s.gender,
  ss.code AS social_status_code,
  ss.description_ru AS social_status_ru,
  s.transport_cost_min,
  s.transport_cost_max,
  s.income_min,
  s.income_max,
  s.home_readable_address,
  ST_X(s.home_address) AS home_lon,
  ST_Y(s.home_address) AS home_lat,
  s.home_city_id AS city_id,
  s.home_city_name AS city_name
FROM movements_form_submissions s
LEFT JOIN social_statuses ss ON ss.id = s.social_status_id

fields.name: gender_ru

  ELSE gender
END

datasets.name: Dataset 2: movements 05/13/2026 10:07:59
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  m.id AS movement_id,
  m.movements_form_submission_id AS submission_id,
  s.movements_date,
  s.gender,

  ss.code AS social_status_code,
  ss.description_ru AS social_status_ru,

  mt.code AS movement_type_code,
  mt.description_ru AS movement_type_ru,

  dpt.code AS origin_place_type,
  dpt.description_ru AS origin_place_type_ru,

  dst.code AS destination_place_type,
  dst.description_ru AS destination_place_type_ru,

  vs.code AS validation_status_code,
  vs.description_ru AS validation_status_ru,

  COALESCE(vt.code, 'NONE') AS vehicle_type_code,
  COALESCE(vt.description_ru, 'без транспорта') AS vehicle_type_ru,

  m.departure_time,
  m.destination_time,
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM m.departure_time) AS departure_hour,
  EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM m.departure_time) AS departure_weekday_num,
  CASE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM m.departure_time)
    WHEN 1 THEN '1 Пн'
    WHEN 2 THEN '2 Вт'
    WHEN 3 THEN '3 Ср'
    WHEN 4 THEN '4 Чт'
    WHEN 5 THEN '5 Пт'
    WHEN 6 THEN '6 Сб'
    WHEN 7 THEN '7 Вс'
  END AS departure_weekday,

  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (m.destination_time - m.departure_time)) / 60.0 AS duration_min,
  m.waiting_time,
  m.cost,
  m.seats_amount,
  m.comment,

  ST_X(m.departure_place) AS departure_lon,
  ST_Y(m.departure_place) AS departure_lat,
  ST_X(m.destination_place) AS destination_lon,
  ST_Y(m.destination_place) AS destination_lat,

  s.home_city_id AS city_id,
  s.home_city_name AS city_name
FROM movements m
JOIN movements_form_submissions s ON s.id = m.movements_form_submission_id
LEFT JOIN social_statuses ss ON ss.id = s.social_status_id
JOIN ref_movement_type mt ON mt.id = m.movement_type_id
JOIN ref_place_type dpt ON dpt.id = m.departure_place_type_id
JOIN ref_place_type dst ON dst.id = m.destination_place_type_id
JOIN ref_validation_status vs ON vs.id = m.validation_status_id
LEFT JOIN ref_vehicle_type vt ON vt.id = m.vehicle_type_id

metrics.name: valid_rate
metrics.expression: sum(case when validation_status_code = 'VALID' then 1 else 0 end) / count(*)

semanticNotes.detail: Submissions have one row per submission_id; movements have one row per movement_id. Related filtering must use EXISTS to avoid multiplying submissions.
movements_per_submission excludes submissions with zero matching movements.

Export valid_rate divides integer SUM by integer COUNT, truncating fractional rates. Preserve source expression for audit; require explicit decimal correction for native metric. It also lacks NULLIF for an empty dataset.
Ad hoc COUNT(gender), COUNT(social_status_code), COUNT(movement_type_code) exclude NULL; do not replace with COUNT(*).
Weekly chart groups movements_date with P1W and lower bound 2022; calendar groups submission_created_at over rolling previous three months.
Composite map overlays chart 26 and 27; source defines no numerical subtraction despite title.
Global cross-filter scopes include incompatible datasets. gender_ru only exists in submissions; vehicle and movement fields only in movements. Explicit mappings/relationships required.

Native city filter root scope includes whole dashboard but stored chartsInScope lists only chart IDs 2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,16. Native import must resolve deliberately, not assume exported interactions cover all 20 charts.
SQL uses ST_X/ST_Y without ST_Transform. Verify input SRID and geographic coordinate range before plotting.
Chart config and dashboard layout/config preserve Superset declarative settings. Importer must translate them; these objects are reference input, not executable native render configs.
